en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a small railway station complex. The central building has a steep roof and wooden facade with the word "ELVERUM" on it. There are tracks and a fence in the foreground, several smaller station buildings, and a few people standing on the platform. Forested hills and scattered buildings appear in the distant background. At the bottom of the front side, printed text reads "Fra Elverum" and a publisher mark "N. K. No. 136".
